title.rendered: Word for the day: How do I Please God – Pastor Chris Onayinka

excerpt.rendered: This question arises because we aren’t paying attention to what He values the most . When you know a man’s heart desire ,it’s not difficult to please him…

content.rendered:
This question arises because we aren’t paying attention to what He values the most .
When you know a man’s heart desire ,it’s not difficult to please him
Gods most precious thoughts ,plans are for man .
The salvation of souls .
The Son of man came to seek and save those who are lost .
No amount of industry ,human activity or even extensive benevolence can substitute this .
This is the Fathers will .
Most precious desire .
To see the non -believer believe and receive salvation
Luke 15:7 KJV
[7] I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repenteth, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance.
Note the term ” more than ”
There is joy that we are living right ,attending church ,growing in knowledge but” MORE” joy that sinners are saved
Rekindle ,or increase your commitment to reach the lost .
This is His will.
You have a blessed week ahead .
I call you blessed
Jesus is Lord,We win !
